planner_json.title: Install, load and invoke Codex on both tracks
depends_on: GAW-1 (the adapter contract, declarations, stance table, probe runner and real-cli test harness this adapter builds on)
GAW-2 (the stop_at option its must-ask entry passes to the runtime)

write_prohibited: plugins/pixel-perfect/** - no plugin change in this task
Any keyed step in `.github/workflows/harness-eval.yml` except Codex's, which gains one line
Any file not listed in WRITE-ALLOWED

seed/pinned-codex.description: @openai/codex at the pinned version installed by npm under a temp prefix, with a temp HOME and CODEX_HOME and an allowlisted env

specification.objective: Codex installs, loads and runs through the adapter contract on both tracks, with status read-only and verify workspace-write.
specification.success_state: A keyless load at 0.160.1 proves the cached plugin's digest equals the checkout's and lists 11 of 11 commands. Each graded entry's argv records its approved sandbox, and no key means no request. The registry serves this adapter, and the keyed step runs the denied-write probe on pinned.

requirements.description: GIVEN the pinned Codex CLI under a temp prefix with a temp HOME and CODEX_HOME and an allowlisted env WHEN the adapter's keyless load runs against this checkout, then the identity check runs against a copy of the cache with one byte changed THEN `observed_cli_version` reads `0.160.1` with `identity_decision.ok` true, 11 of 11 command names are present in a raw list of 13, and the changed copy reads `installation-identity-mismatch` naming `observed_plugin_manifest_sha256`
requirements.verification_service: real @openai/codex at the pinned version in a temp HOME
requirements.positive_example: Fresh temp HOME: identity approved at 0.160.1, loaded digest equal to the checkout digest, and all 11 command names in the list.
requirements.red: On base the registry answers codex-adapter-not-implemented, no load runs, and the identity assertion fails.

scenario.verification_service: real @openai/codex at the pinned version in a temp HOME

would_fail_if: the digest is computed from the checkout twice, so a stale cache passes
the list is a static array of names
a credential is present in the child env

build_proof.range: anything that proves the plugin Codex runs is byte-for-byte this checkout's
examples: hashing the plugin cache directory the install created

steps: run the adapter's keyless load against this checkout
change one byte in a copy of the cache and run the identity check against that copy

must_observe: 11 of 11 command names present, and the raw list holds 13
the changed copy reads reason `installation-identity-mismatch` naming `observed_plugin_manifest_sha256`

requirements.description: GIVEN the adapter's real invocation table with every credential removed WHEN each graded entry and both probe entries run through the real guard and capture, and the persisted captures are read THEN status holds `--sandbox` `read-only`, both verify entries hold `--sandbox` `workspace-write`, the required probe holds `read-only` with a prompt naming `work/keep.txt`, and each record reads `missing-api-key` with `model_request_count` 0
requirements.verification_service: real guard and capture over the adapter's real invocation table
requirements.positive_example: Keyless run of every entry: refusal captures record --sandbox read-only for status and --sandbox workspace-write for verify, with the literal prompt starting $pixel-perfect:, and the required probe entry names work/keep.txt.
requirements.red: On base no codex table exists, so reading its argv from a persisted refusal capture fails.

scenario.verification_service: real guard and capture over the adapter's real invocation table

would_fail_if: both checks use one sandbox, so the split is absent
the guard is removed and a keyless entry spawns the CLI

build_proof.range: anything that proves the capability split and the keyless refusal hold for every codex entry

must_observe: the required probe's argv holds `--sandbox` `read-only` and a prompt naming `work/keep.txt`
must_not_observe: a capture with no argv recorded
